# Live verification — 2026-10-06

The C1 source pack uses a representation-level trust model. Current mutable sources were checked for current official identity/version or page state on 2026-10-06; immutable judgments were checked for fixed official identity.

For the 19 foundational CJEU judgments, CELEX identity, case identity, judgment date and ECLI were checked against EUR-Lex. For the Commission and European Ombudsman operational complaint pages, current official page identity and the operational propositions recorded in their normalized notes were checked.

The verification standard does not require byte-identical transport from the official site. Exact wording and pinpoint reliance remain analysis-time verification tasks.
